properties.description: Profile family to unassign. Allowed values are exactly "Server", "Chassis", "Domain", and "Unified Edge". Domain and Unified Edge use fabric.SwitchClusterProfile with their distinct TargetPlatform values.

properties.name: Profile Organization
properties.description: Cisco Intersight organization containing the profile. The value is matched exactly and OData-escaped; the current organization.Organization Name schema permits 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, colons, or hyphens.

properties.name: Profile Name
properties.description: Exact profile name. The current policy.AbstractProfile Name schema permits 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, or hyphens. The value is OData-escaped and scoped to Profile Organization.

properties.name: Confirm Unassign
properties.description: Required destructive-action confirmation. Set this value to true to allow Action=Unassign. Any false or malformed value stops before the first API request.

properties.name: Wait for Completion
properties.description: When false, success means Cisco Intersight accepted Action=Unassign; target release is not verified. When true, the workflow performs bounded polling and succeeds only on ConfigContext.ConfigStateSummary=Not-assigned.

properties.name: Wait Timeout Seconds
properties.description: Conditionally required when Wait for Completion is true. Enter an integer from 1 through 600. The value bounds the unassignment polling window; it is ignored when waiting is false.

properties.name: Status Code
properties.description: HTTP-style final outcome code. A non-waiting accepted request preserves the PATCH 2xx status, completed unassignment uses 200, timeout uses 408, validation/cardinality failures use 4xx values, and handled helper/API failures use 500/502.

properties.description: Requires Confirm Unassign=true; validates Profile Type, current organization/profile Name schema constraints, the boolean wait choice, and the conditional 1-600 second timeout. It escapes both names for OData single-quoted literals and maps Server, Chassis, Domain, and Unified Edge to their OpenAPI collection, concrete ObjectType, and TargetPlatform selector.
properties.display_name: Validate inputs, escape OData values, and prepare profile route
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

preparationStatus = "helper-failure"
preparationStatusCode = "500"
preparationMessage = "Workflow input preparation did not complete."
preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": preparationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
escapedOrganizationName = ""
escapedProfileName = ""
profileCollection = ""
profileItemBase = ""
expectedObjectType = ""
expectedTargetPlatform = ""
profileFilterSuffix = ""
waitRequested = ""
waitTimeoutSeconds = 0

ORGANIZATION_NAME_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$")
PROFILE_NAME_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,64}$")
ROUTES = {
    "Server": ("/api/v1/server/Profiles", "server.Profile", ""),
    "Chassis": ("/api/v1/chassis/Profiles", "chassis.Profile", ""),
    "Domain": ("/api/v1/fabric/SwitchClusterProfiles", "fabric.SwitchClusterProfile", "UCS Domain"),
    "Unified Edge": ("/api/v1/fabric/SwitchClusterProfiles", "fabric.SwitchClusterProfile", "Unified Edge")
}

try:
    profileType = sys.argv[1]
    organization = sys.argv[2]
    profileName = sys.argv[3]
    confirmText = sys.argv[4].strip().lower()
    waitText = sys.argv[5].strip().lower()
    timeoutText = sys.argv[6].strip()

    escapedOrganizationName = organization.replace("'", "''")
    escapedProfileName = profileName.replace("'", "''")
    errors = []

    if profileType not in ROUTES:
        errors.append("Profile Type must be exactly Server, Chassis, Domain, or Unified Edge.")
    if not organization:
        errors.append("Profile Organization must not be blank.")
    elif not ORGANIZATION_NAME_PATTERN.fullmatch(organization):
        errors.append("Profile Organization must match the current organization.Organization Name schema: 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, colons, or hyphens.")
    if not profileName:
        errors.append("Profile Name must not be blank.")
    elif not PROFILE_NAME_PATTERN.fullmatch(profileName):
        errors.append("Profile Name must match the current policy.AbstractProfile Name schema: 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, or hyphens.")

    if confirmText not in ("true", "1"):
        errors.append("Confirm Unassign must be true before the workflow can submit Action=Unassign.")

    if waitText in ("true", "1"):
        waitRequested = "true"
    elif waitText in ("false", "0"):
        waitRequested = "false"
    else:
        errors.append("Wait for Completion must be a boolean value.")
        waitRequested = "invalid"

    try:
        waitTimeoutSeconds = int(timeoutText)
    except Exception:
        waitTimeoutSeconds = -1
        errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds must be an integer.")

    if waitRequested == "true" and not (1 <= waitTimeoutSeconds <= 600):
        errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds is required when waiting and must be between 1 and 600 seconds.")
    if waitRequested == "false" and waitTimeoutSeconds < 0:
        errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds must not be negative.")

    if errors:
        preparationStatus = "invalid"
        preparationStatusCode = "400"
        preparationMessage = " ".join(errors)
        preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Input validation failed", "details": errors}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        profileCollection, expectedObjectType, expectedTargetPlatform = ROUTES[profileType]
        profileItemBase = profileCollection
        if expectedTargetPlatform:
            profileFilterSuffix = " and TargetPlatform eq '" + expectedTargetPlatform.replace("'", "''") + "'"
        preparationStatus = "ready"
        preparationStatusCode = "200"
        preparationMessage = "Confirmation, inputs, schema constraints, profile routing, wait bounds, and OData values are valid."
        preparationResultJson = json.dumps({
            "validated": True,
            "confirmUnassign": True,
            "profileType": profileType,
            "waitForCompletion": waitRequested == "true",
            "waitTimeoutSeconds": waitTimeoutSeconds if waitRequested == "true" else None,
            "collection": profileCollection,
            "expectedObjectType": expectedObjectType,
            "expectedTargetPlatform": expectedTargetPlatform or None
        }, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    preparationStatus = "helper-failure"
    preparationStatusCode = "500"
    preparationMessage = str(exc)
    preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Workflow input preparation failed", "detail": preparationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.script:
import json
import sys

organizationStatus = "helper-failure"
organizationStatusCode = "500"
organizationMessage = "Organization lookup inspection did not complete."
organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": organizationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
organizationMoid = ""

try:
    payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedName = sys.argv[2]
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("The organization response body is not a JSON object.")
    results = payload.get("Results")
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("The organization response does not contain a Results array.")
    count = len(results)
    if count != 1:
        organizationStatus = "cardinality"
        organizationStatusCode = "404" if count == 0 else "409"
        organizationMessage = "The organization lookup returned %d matches; exactly one is required." % count
        organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Organization lookup cardinality failure", "matchCount": count, "requiredMatchCount": 1}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("The single organization result is not a JSON object.")
        moid = item.get("Moid")
        name = item.get("Name")
        objectType = item.get("ObjectType")
        if not isinstance(moid, str) or not moid.strip():
            organizationStatus = "invalid-resource"
            organizationStatusCode = "502"
            organizationMessage = "The matching organization is missing a usable Moid."
        elif name != expectedName:
            organizationStatus = "invalid-resource"
            organizationStatusCode = "502"
            organizationMessage = "The matching organization Name does not equal the requested exact value."
        elif objectType != "organization.Organization":
            organizationStatus = "invalid-resource"
            organizationStatusCode = "502"
            organizationMessage = "The matching resource ObjectType is not organization.Organization."
        else:
            organizationMoid = moid
            organizationStatus = "ready"
            organizationStatusCode = "200"
            organizationMessage = "Exactly one organization with the expected identity was resolved."
            organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"Moid": moid, "Name": name, "ObjectType": objectType}, separators=(",", ":"))
        if organizationStatus == "invalid-resource":
            organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": organizationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    organizationStatus = "helper-failure"
    organizationStatusCode = "500"
    organizationMessage = str(exc)
    organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Organization lookup inspection failed", "detail": organizationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.script:
import json
import sys

profileStatus = "helper-failure"
profileStatusCode = "500"
profileMessage = "Profile lookup inspection did not complete."
profileResultJson = json.dumps({"error": profileMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
profileMoid = ""

try:
    payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedName = sys.argv[2]
    expectedOrganizationMoid = sys.argv[3]
    expectedObjectType = sys.argv[4]
    expectedTargetPlatform = sys.argv[5]
    profileType = sys.argv[6]
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("The profile response body is not a JSON object.")
    results = payload.get("Results")
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("The profile response does not contain a Results array.")
    count = len(results)
    if count != 1:
        profileStatus = "cardinality"
        profileStatusCode = "404" if count == 0 else "409"
        profileMessage = "The %s profile lookup returned %d matches; exactly one is required." % (profileType, count)
        profileResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Profile lookup cardinality failure", "profileType": profileType, "matchCount": count, "requiredMatchCount": 1}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("The single profile result is not a JSON object.")
        moid = item.get("Moid")
        name = item.get("Name")
        objectType = item.get("ObjectType")
        targetPlatform = item.get("TargetPlatform")
        organization = item.get("Organization")
        organizationMoid = organization.get("Moid") if isinstance(organization, dict) else None
        error = ""
        if not isinstance(moid, str) or not moid.strip():
            error = "The matching profile is missing a usable Moid."
        elif name != expectedName:
            error = "The matching profile Name does not equal the requested exact value."
        elif objectType != expectedObjectType:
            error = "The matching profile ObjectType does not equal the mapped concrete profile type."
        elif organizationMoid != expectedOrganizationMoid:
            error = "The matching profile Organization relationship does not equal the resolved organization Moid."
        elif expectedTargetPlatform and targetPlatform != expectedTargetPlatform:
            error = "The matching switch cluster profile TargetPlatform does not equal the requested profile type."
        if error:
            profileStatus = "invalid-resource"
            profileStatusCode = "502"
            profileMessage = error
            profileResultJson = json.dumps({"error": error, "profileType": profileType}, separators=(",", ":"))
        else:
            profileMoid = moid
            context = item.get("ConfigContext")
            priorState = context.get("ConfigStateSummary") if isinstance(context, dict) else None
            profileStatus = "ready"
            profileStatusCode = "200"
            profileMessage = "Exactly one %s profile with the expected identity was resolved." % profileType
            profileResultJson = json.dumps({
                "Moid": moid,
                "Name": name,
                "ObjectType": objectType,
                "TargetPlatform": targetPlatform,
                "OrganizationMoid": organizationMoid,
                "ConfigStateSummaryBeforeRequest": priorState
            }, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    profileStatus = "helper-failure"
    profileStatusCode = "500"
    profileMessage = str(exc)
    profileResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Profile lookup inspection failed", "detail": profileMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

import json
import sys

acceptanceStatus = "helper-failure"
acceptanceStatusCode = "500"
acceptanceMessage = "Unassign response inspection did not complete."
acceptanceResultJson = json.dumps({"error": acceptanceMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

try:
    item = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedMoid = sys.argv[2]
    expectedName = sys.argv[3]
    expectedObjectType = sys.argv[4]
    expectedTargetPlatform = sys.argv[5]
    profileType = sys.argv[6]
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        raise ValueError("The Unassign response body is not a JSON object.")
    moid = item.get("Moid")
    name = item.get("Name")
    objectType = item.get("ObjectType")
    targetPlatform = item.get("TargetPlatform")
    error = ""
    if moid != expectedMoid:
        error = "The Unassign response Moid does not match the selected profile."
    elif name != expectedName:
        error = "The Unassign response Name does not match the selected profile."
    elif objectType != expectedObjectType:
        error = "The Unassign response ObjectType does not match the mapped concrete profile type."
    elif expectedTargetPlatform and targetPlatform != expectedTargetPlatform:
        error = "The Unassign response TargetPlatform does not match the requested profile type."
    if error:
        acceptanceStatus = "invalid-resource"
        acceptanceStatusCode = "502"
        acceptanceMessage = error
        acceptanceResultJson = json.dumps({"error": error, "requestMayHaveBeenAccepted": True, "profileType": profileType}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        context = item.get("ConfigContext")
        returnedState = context.get("ConfigStateSummary") if isinstance(context, dict) else None
        acceptanceStatus = "ready"
        acceptanceStatusCode = "202"
        acceptanceMessage = "Cisco Intersight accepted the %s profile Unassign request; target release has not been verified." % profileType
        acceptanceResultJson = json.dumps({
            "requestAccepted": True,
            "completionVerified": False,
            "Moid": moid,
            "Name": name,
            "ObjectType": objectType,
            "TargetPlatform": targetPlatform,
            "returnedAction": item.get("Action"),
            "returnedConfigStateSummary": returnedState
        }, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    acceptanceStatus = "helper-failure"
    acceptanceStatusCode = "500"
    acceptanceMessage = str(exc)

properties.description: Starts the 1-600 second wait window only after the Unassign request is accepted. It derives an initial transition delay of at most two seconds and four bounded inter-poll delays, each below the 180-second helper action timeout, for at most five profile GET attempts.

properties.script:
import json
import sys
import time

pollingStatus = "helper-failure"
pollingStatusCode = "500"
pollingMessage = "Polling deadline initialization did not complete."
pollingResultJson = json.dumps({"error": pollingMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
deadlineEpoch = ""
initialDelaySeconds = ""
pollIntervalSeconds = ""

try:
    timeout = int(sys.argv[1])
    if timeout < 1 or timeout > 600:
        raise ValueError("The normalized wait timeout must be between 1 and 600 seconds.")
    now = time.time()
    initialDelay = min(2.0, max(0.25, timeout / 20.0))
    interval = max(1.0, max(0.0, timeout - initialDelay) / 4.0)
    if initialDelay > 2.0 or interval >= 180.0:
        raise ValueError("The derived polling delays exceed safe helper action bounds.")
    deadlineEpoch = "%.6f" % (now + timeout)
    initialDelaySeconds = "%.6f" % initialDelay
    pollIntervalSeconds = "%.6f" % interval
    pollingStatus = "ready"
    pollingStatusCode = "200"
    pollingMessage = "A bounded polling deadline and safe delay schedule were initialized."
    pollingResultJson = json.dumps({
        "waitTimeoutSeconds": timeout,
        "initialDelaySeconds": initialDelay,
        "pollIntervalSeconds": interval,
        "maximumPollAttempts": 5
    }, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    pollingStatus = "helper-failure"
    pollingStatusCode = "500"
    pollingMessage = str(exc)
    pollingResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Polling deadline initialization failed", "detail": pollingMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.script:
import json
import sys
import time

waitStatus = "helper-failure"
waitStatusCode = "500"
waitMessage = "Polling delay did not complete."
waitResultJson = json.dumps({"error": waitMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

try:
    deadline = float(sys.argv[1])
    initialDelay = float(sys.argv[2])
    pollInterval = float(sys.argv[3])
    attempt = int(sys.argv[4])
    stagePrefix = sys.argv[5]
    if attempt < 1 or attempt > 5:
        raise ValueError("The polling attempt must be between 1 and 5.")
    requestedDelay = initialDelay if attempt == 1 else pollInterval
    stage = stagePrefix + " " + str(attempt)
    if requestedDelay < 0 or requestedDelay >= 180:
        raise ValueError("The requested polling delay is outside the safe helper action bound.")
    remaining = deadline - time.time()
    if remaining <= 0:
        waitStatus = "timeout"
        waitStatusCode = "408"
        waitMessage = "The unassignment wait deadline was reached before " + stage + "."
        waitResultJson = json.dumps({"requestAccepted": True, "completionVerified": False, "timeout": True, "stage": stage}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        actualDelay = min(requestedDelay, remaining)
        time.sleep(actualDelay)
        waitStatus = "ready"
        waitStatusCode = "200"
        waitMessage = "The bounded delay before " + stage + " completed."
        waitResultJson = json.dumps({"stage": stage, "requestedDelaySeconds": requestedDelay, "actualDelaySeconds": actualDelay}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    waitStatus = "helper-failure"
    waitStatusCode = "500"
    waitMessage = str(exc)
    waitResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Polling delay helper failed", "detail": waitMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

actions.name: Execute Python Script
actions.title: Inspect profile unassignment state (current attempt)

properties.description: Validates the polled resource identity and ConfigContext.ConfigStateSummary. Not-assigned is the only success state; Failed and every unrecognized or unsafe state fail closed; only the explicit bounded unassignment-progress allowlist can continue.
properties.display_name: Inspect profile unassignment state (current attempt)
properties.script:
import json
import sys

pollStatus = "helper-failure"
pollStatusCode = "500"
pollMessage = "Profile unassignment state inspection did not complete."
pollResultJson = json.dumps({"error": pollMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
configStateSummary = ""

UNASSIGN_PROGRESS_STATES = {
    "Associated", "Assigned", "Preparing", "Validating", "Evaluating",
    "Configuring", "UnConfiguring", "Analyzing", "Activating", "Waiting-for-resource"
}

try:
    item = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedMoid = sys.argv[2]
    expectedName = sys.argv[3]
    expectedObjectType = sys.argv[4]
    expectedTargetPlatform = sys.argv[5]
    profileType = sys.argv[6]
    attempt = int(sys.argv[7])
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        raise ValueError("The profile polling response body is not a JSON object.")
    moid = item.get("Moid")
    name = item.get("Name")
    objectType = item.get("ObjectType")
    targetPlatform = item.get("TargetPlatform")
    if moid != expectedMoid:
        raise ValueError("The polled profile Moid does not match the selected profile.")
    if name != expectedName:
        raise ValueError("The polled profile Name does not match the selected profile.")
    if objectType != expectedObjectType:
        raise ValueError("The polled profile ObjectType does not match the mapped concrete profile type.")
    if expectedTargetPlatform and targetPlatform != expectedTargetPlatform:
        raise ValueError("The polled profile TargetPlatform does not match the requested profile type.")
    context = item.get("ConfigContext")
    if not isinstance(context, dict):
        raise ValueError("The polled profile is missing a ConfigContext object.")
    state = context.get("ConfigStateSummary")
    if not isinstance(state, str) or not state:
        raise ValueError("The polled ConfigContext is missing ConfigStateSummary.")
    configStateSummary = state
    base = {
        "requestAccepted": True,
        "profileType": profileType,
        "Moid": moid,
        "Name": name,
        "ObjectType": objectType,
        "TargetPlatform": targetPlatform,
        "pollAttempt": attempt,
        "ConfigStateSummary": state
    }
    if state == "Not-assigned":
        pollStatus = "success"
        pollStatusCode = "200"
        pollMessage = "The %s profile unassignment completed with ConfigStateSummary=Not-assigned." % profileType
        base["unassignmentCompleted"] = True
    elif state == "Failed":
        pollStatus = "failure"
        pollStatusCode = "502"
        pollMessage = "The %s profile Unassign action reported ConfigStateSummary=Failed." % profileType
        base["unassignmentCompleted"] = False
    elif state in UNASSIGN_PROGRESS_STATES:
        pollStatus = "in-progress"
        pollStatusCode = "202"
        pollMessage = "The %s profile unassignment is still in progress with ConfigStateSummary=%s." % (profileType, state)
        base["unassignmentCompleted"] = False
    else:
        pollStatus = "failure"
        pollStatusCode = "502"
        pollMessage = "ConfigStateSummary=%s is neither Not-assigned nor an explicitly allowed unassignment-progress state; polling stopped fail-closed." % state
        base["unassignmentCompleted"] = False
        base["failClosed"] = True
    pollResultJson = json.dumps(base, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    pollStatus = "helper-failure"
    pollStatusCode = "500"
    pollMessage = str(exc)
    pollResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Profile unassignment state inspection failed", "detail": pollMessage, "requestAccepted": True}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.description: Unassigns one Server, Chassis, Domain, or Unified Edge profile after Confirm Unassign is true. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose runtime user can read organizations/profiles and update the selected profile. It resolves exact identity, validates ObjectType and switch-cluster TargetPlatform, then PATCHes only Action=Unassign. Wait=false means HTTP 2xx plus matching response proves acceptance only; release is unverified. Wait=true uses a bounded 1-600 second, five-attempt schedule and succeeds only at ConfigStateSummary=Not-assigned; Failed or any state outside the progress allowlist fails closed. A final GET may finish after deadline. Server and switch-cluster behavior is documented; Chassis requires live-tenant testing. Generic APIs are used because no cross-profile unassign/status atomic exists.
